ValidationRule.description: Check the campaign dates, threshold, and reward value.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Check the campaign dates, threshold, and reward value.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(Start_Date__c > End_Date__c, Threshold__c < 0, AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Condition_Field__c, "Liters")), Threshold__c <> ROUND(Threshold__c, 2)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Reward_Type__c, "FixedBonus"), OR(Reward_Value__c <= 0, MOD(Reward_Value__c, 1) <> 0)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Reward_Type__c, "BaseMultiplier"), Reward_Value__c < 1))
